Name: (CP) Dacar vanilla  anime style portraits
Author: DacarTheGorilla
Description:
[b][color=#ff0000]**The CP version for 1.6 of this mod currently  needs Portraiture to work, once HD portraits is updated I'll change it**[/color]

[/b][color=#00ff00]**--Instructions for 1.6 CP for Portaiture--*
Just download the mod and put it in the mods folder.
In order to see the portraits you'll need Portraiture and do one of this two things:

-Once inside the game press "P" (by default it may be different depending on your settings) until you see HDP

-In Portraiture config setting  change this to not have to cycle through your portraits:
"active": "HDP" 

CP version works better for the new winter outfits[/color]


This mod has a version for  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url], in case you don't want to use CP.

﻿I made this mod because I really liked [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5269]Talkohlooeys [/url]portraits but also wanted to have other mods like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url] in my game.


[img]https://i.postimg.cc/6509pQY9/Next-Projects.png[/img]

Next mod will be:
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]ESR[/url]  and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16045][color=#8e7cc3]East Scarp Seasonals[/color][/url] (I need to finish the new NPCs and clothes)

After that I will be making one of this mods if I get the okay, pretty much in this order:

- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11111]Sunberry Village[/url] ﻿
- [color=#ff0000][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9999]Always Raining in the valley[/url][/color]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10770]Sen - Lurking in the dark[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6626]Lunna[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10016]Lavril[/url] (Maybe this one will have to wait till is back up)
